labels: A student sits on the corridor floor with one palm planted behind the hip and one bent knee drawn up, while a dropped bag lies separately beside the other leg.; 학생이 복도 바닥에 앉아 한 손바닥을 엉덩이 뒤에 짚고 한 무릎을 세우며 떨어진 가방은 반대 다리 옆에 따로 놓인다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A student sits on the corridor floor with one palm planted behind the hip and one bent knee drawn up, while a dropped bag lies separately beside the other leg.
aliases: 넘어진 뒤의 바닥 지지
